Paragraphe · Cast iron skillets are often the cente…
blocks_element.text: Cast iron skillets are often the centerpiece for special moments in our lives—family traditions, holiday dinners, and big celebrations. Now you can engrave a giftable, personalized skillet that’s specially designed by you to commemorate those big moments. Plus, they make a perfect gift! Give an engraved skillet for a special anniversary, wedding gift, housewarming present, or to celebrate gradations and awards. Choose from our pre-set designs.

Paragraphe · Lodge has long history of working with…
blocks_element.text: Lodge has long history of working with artists to create limited-edition cast iron, each piece telling its own story. Now, you can be part of that legacy—collaborating with Lodge to design your own one-of-a-kind cast iron to mark life’s special moments with friends and family.

blocks_element.repere: Grand titre · We love crafting one-of-a-kind pieces …
blocks_element.text: We love crafting one-of-a-kind pieces for your family.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · For decades, Lodge has worked with com…
blocks_element.text: For decades, Lodge has worked with companies of all sizes to create brand-forward pans as giveaways and gifts. And now, we’ve got a custom engraved option to help you commemorate big moments for the employees and fans of your business.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Can I cook with my custom skillet?
blocks_element.text: Can I cook with my custom skillet?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Of course! You can cook with and care …
blocks_element.text: Of course! You can cook with and care for your skillet just like any other piece of cast iron! Just a heads up, the engraved section of the skillet will darken over time. If you prefer to maintain the color of the skillet, we recommend using this skillet as a decorative piece and reaching for one of our classic skillets to cook with.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · How do I care for my skillet?
blocks_element.text: How do I care for my skillet?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · If you choose to cook with your skille…
blocks_element.text: If you choose to cook with your skillet, care for it like you would any piece of cast iron. After you cook: wash with warm, soapy water, dry thoroughly, and add a thin layer of cooking oil to protect from rust. Want more tips? Read our Beginner’s Guide to Cast Iron.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · How are the Custom Skillets engraved?
blocks_element.text: How are the Custom Skillets engraved?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Custom Skillets start out in the same …
blocks_element.text: Custom Skillets start out in the same place as all of our other cookware: they’re made in our foundry in South Pittsburg, TN. After, they come to our Custom Shop, where experienced techs use a special engraving machine to create your personalized skillet. This machine provides the precision we need to bring each design to life.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Why do the Custom Skillets have a bron…
blocks_element.text: Why do the Custom Skillets have a bronze patina?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · After our Custom Skillets are engraved…
blocks_element.text: After our Custom Skillets are engraved, they are seasoned for a second time—but this time with flax seed oil, which imparts a bronze tone to the engraved section of your skillet.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Where does the design go?
Paragraphe · The design is engraved on the bottom o…
blocks_element.text: The design is engraved on the bottom of the skillet—just like our logo skillets.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Can I update the design after I’ve pla…
blocks_element.text: Can I update the design after I’ve placed my order?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · No, it’s important to review your desi…
blocks_element.text: No, it’s important to review your design before placing your order, as we cannot accommodate changes once the order has been placed. Terms and conditions apply.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Can I upload my own design?
blocks_element.text: Can I upload my own design?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · At this time, we’re only able to creat…
blocks_element.text: At this time, we’re only able to create skillets with customizable, pre-set designs.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · What are the guidelines for my order?
blocks_element.text: What are the guidelines for my order?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · We ask that you keep it clean and fami…
blocks_element.text: We ask that you keep it clean and family-friendly. We won’t be able to fulfill orders with profanity, objectionable words or phrases, or anything with a registered trademark (like famous names or brands). See our Terms and Conditions for more information.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · We have five templates that you can ch…
blocks_element.text: We have five templates that you can choose from to create your custom skillet. After you choose your design, you will be able to personalize your skillet, using the English alphabet and staying within the character limits for your design. At this time, we aren’t able to engrave skillets with accents or non-English characters.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · How many custom skillets can I order?
blocks_element.text: How many custom skillets can I order?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · At this time, we’re only able to proce…
blocks_element.text: At this time, we’re only able to process five (5) custom skillets per order. If you’d like to place a larger order, please reach out to our Customer Care Team and they will be able to assist you.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · How quickly will I get my order?
blocks_element.text: How quickly will I get my order?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Because this is a custom piece, we’ll …
blocks_element.text: Because this is a custom piece, we’ll need a little more time to get everything ready to go. Typically, we’re able to process an order within four to five weeks. We’ll send you an email as soon as the skillet ships!

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · What is the shipping cost?
Paragraphe · There will be a $8.99 shipping fee for…
blocks_element.text: There will be a $8.99 shipping fee for all Custom Skillet orders.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · How is the skillet shipped?
Paragraphe · The skillet is shipped in a craft gift…
blocks_element.text: The skillet is shipped in a craft gift box designed for a special unboxing experience. Don’t worry, the shipping label will be placed on the bottom of the carton and will not be placed over any designs on the box. Because it is shipped in the gift box, be mindful that it will not be in discrete packaging when it arrives.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Can custom skillets be returned?
Paragraphe · If your custom cast iron skillet arriv…
blocks_element.text: If your custom cast iron skillet arrives improperly engraved, broken, or damaged, please reach out to our Customer Care Team for help with making a return. Please note: We will NOT be able to return items due to mistakes in your reviewed and submitted design. It’s very important to carefully review your custom design before purchasing. See our Terms and Conditions for more information.
